components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid accent action; drops to accent-700 on hover and active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--keen-accent, #7e57c2); color: var(--keen-accent-contrast, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--keen-accent, #7e57c2); border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--keen-accent-700, #6a3fb2); border-color: var(--keen-accent-700, #6a3fb2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.25); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tinted-outline secondary action; fills solid accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--keen-accent-700, #6a3fb2); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.55); border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--keen-accent, #7e57c2); color: var(--keen-accent-contrast, #fff); border-color: var(--keen-accent, #7e57c2); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.25); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Glassy soft panel with accent-tinted border, gradient header and ambient shadow.
components.html:
Coverage
Mapped to 128 collected events.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: var(--keen-ink, #1f1f2a); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.20); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20, 20, 40, 0.06); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.10) 0%, rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.02) 100%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.18); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1rem; }

components.name: KPI Block
components.description: Translucent metric tile: 12px muted label over a 22px/700 value.
components.css: .ds-kpi { display: inline-block; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.22); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(20, 20, 40, 0.05); padding: 14px 16px; color: var(--keen-ink, #1f1f2a); } .ds-kpi-label { color: var(--keen-muted, #5e5e75); font-size: 12px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.2px; }

components.name: Soft Badge
components.css: .ds-badge-soft { display: inline-block; background: rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.24); color: var(--keen-accent-700, #6a3fb2); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75em; padding: 0.35em 0.65em; border-radius: 0.375rem; }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Fully rounded tag with optional colour dot.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; background: rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.14); color: var(--keen-accent-700, #6a3fb2); } .ds-tag-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Glassy form field with accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); color: var(--keen-ink, #1f1f2a); border: 1px solid rgba(31,31,42,0.20); border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--keen-muted, #5e5e75); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--keen-accent, #7e57c2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.25); }

components.name: Pill Tab
components.description: Lightweight in-page tab: 999px pill that fills with the accent wash when active.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-tab { border: none; background: transparent; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; color: #6c757d; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.06); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--keen-accent-100, #f2ecfb); color: var(--keen-accent-700, #6a3fb2); }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Fixed accent bar with white pills for hover/active links and the glowing brand row.
components.html: KeenControlsEvents
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; background: var(--keen-accent, #7e57c2); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(var(--keen-accent-rgb, 126,87,194), 0.22); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-nav-brand { color: #fff; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 0.75rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: #fff; opacity: 0.95; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.25rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { opacity: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); } .ds-nav-link-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }

narrative.overview: Keen's interface is a calm, airy, quietly confident stack of soft panels in a single accent colour. The page canvas is an airy tinted wash lightened by a radial highlight; on it sit glassy, gently lifted cards with large rounded corners and accent-tinted translucent borders. One accent — Muted Amethyst in the shipped default — is the system's single voice, applied as washes and tints rather than heavy decoration. Depth comes from translucency and diffuse low shadows, not crisp layer boundaries. The system is deliberately themable: the accent palette swaps wholesale by data-theme (seven palettes, each with a dark variant), and typography is the platform's own voice with numbers, identifiers and evidence text in a compact monospace face.
keyCharacteristics: One accent voice, applied as rgba washes and tints over near-white translucent surfaces.
Soft, large radii: 999px pills, 18px cards, 14px media, 10–12px controls.
Depth by translucency plus diffuse ambient shadow.
System sans typography; mono for identifiers, JSON and event payloads.
Full themability through --keen-accent* variables; seven palettes with dark variants.
Bootstrap 5 base with tables as the primary data surface.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: A single accent owns the identity. Never introduce a second decorative hue; role semantics outside the accent (risk score pills, Bootstrap success/warning/danger states) are the only sanctioned exceptions.

rules.name: The Wash-Not-Solid Rule
rules.body: Accent colour is used solid only on the navbar and primary buttons; all other accent application is an rgba tint over white or the wash.

rules.name: The System-Stack Rule
rules.body: No webfonts. Faces come from the platform; express hierarchy through weight and size, not through type purchases.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows signal that a surface exists above the canvas, not that it is more important. Strong accent shadows are reserved for the navbar; everything else barely lifts.

dos: Do theme everything through --keen-accent* variables (and --bs-primary); never hard-code an accent hex in app CSS.
Do apply the accent as an alpha wash (0.06–0.24) for surfaces, borders and tints; reserve solid accent for the navbar and primary buttons.
Do use the established radius scale: 999px pills, 18px cards, 14px media, 10–12px small controls.
Do keep tables sticky-headered on desktop with page-driven scrolling and the body-bg header backing.
Do use .mono for identifiers, tokens and payload text.
Do state dark-variant concerns alongside any new shared component theming in mosp-design-system.
donts: Don't introduce a second decorative accent; semantic status colours (risk pills, Bootstrap states) are the only exceptions.
Don't add webfonts or replace the system type stacks.
Don't use structural or coloured shadows; shadows stay in the ambient vocabulary in Elevation & Depth.
Don't put Keen-generic components into services/ui/public/styles.css; shared things belong in mosp-design-system, Keen-specific overrides stay scoped to Keen's selectors.
Don't clone per-source or per-capability colours into fixed CSS; they are per-entity tints applied via CSS variables (--src-rgb, --cap-color).
Don't rely on rebuilding Bootstrap components in custom JS; pages are static HTML + Bootstrap + the MOSP app.js helpers.
